verdicts.reason: Identical anchors and identical exclusion of authority/consequence; X is only a compressed restatement of Y.
Both reward a concretely implementable alternative design and score 0 for mere objection with no proposal.
Both score addressee-directed itemisation with citation tags as pure layout, with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same content-irrelevance rule.
Both require the commenter's own numeric compliance-cost estimate with its basis stated, and score 0 when no figures appear.
Same filing-window marker list, same 10/5/0 anchors, and the same exclusion of compliance deadlines and other parties' filings.
Both score the stated reasoning link from a sourced figure to an identified provision, with the same worked example and the same dense-but-unlinked-statistics zero.
Both score provision-level engagement with identical 10/5/0 anchors and the same rule that a caption docket/RIN citation is not engagement.
Emotional intensity and first-hand operational experience are separate properties: a flat technical operator account scores high on Y and 0 on X.
Same scale/prestige markers, same prominence anchors, and the same instruction to score the claims as text rather than their evidential force.
Both score de novo scaffolding versus incorporation-by-reference posture with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same correctness exclusion.
Both count references to prior agency contact with identical anchors and both exclude whether the relationship adds anything.
Same assumed-audience markers and anchors; Y merely folds the 'knows the commenter' marker into the shared-history clause.
Both score the concreteness of the described compliance demonstration; Y only makes explicit the mid-anchor a judge would already interpolate in X.
Identical requirement that compliance experience be reported and tied to a provision, with the same 'a relationship is not experience' exclusion.
Both score 10 for one or two sentences and 0 for three or more, on sentence count alone.
Both score substance actually carried over from earlier dealings and applied to the rule, with the same anchors and the same bare-reference zero.
Same pooled/patterned constituency evidence, same instance-level 5, and the same rule that claimed breadth of representation is not evidence.
A developed statutory-authority argument and the mere presence of part/section CFR citations are independent: either can appear without the other.
Both score only whether an attachment/exhibit reference appears, never its content, with identical 10/0 anchors.
Same surface density of figures and named sources, same anchors, and the same explicit numbers-that-go-nowhere-still-count rule.
Both score specificity of an identified legal defect plus cure, with the same 10/5/0 anchors and the same 'not whether the argument prevails' exclusion.
Same adversarial-register phrase list and anchors, both scored as register independent of the argument's accuracy.
Identical list of hands-on particulars, the same industry-generic 5, and the same zero for position-taking with precise rule citations.
Both require named author plus stated role/relationship, with the same vague-standing 5 and the same exclusion of salutations, titles, and letterhead.
Same post-publication record markers, same two-or-more/one/none anchors, and the same exclusion of pre-proposal citations.
Identical list of filing conventions and identical 10/5/0 anchors, scored as formatting presence only in both.
Both score salutation and signature block presence with the same both/one/neither anchors and the same do-not-read-the-body rule.
Same mass-campaign markers, same 10/5/0 anchors, and the same instruction not to score the position taken.
Both score engagement with contrary evidence and its reconciliation; Y only spells out the intermediate acknowledged-but-unreconciled case.
